This advice comes from guides for Northern Ghana and may not suit Adaklu, so check this advice with your local extension agent. Consult your local AEA for advice on the recommended fall army worm control pesticide in your area (APNI). You should check your maize field at least once a week for insect damage, larvae, or stunted growth. Also, think about rotating maize with crops like groundnut, ploughing deeply, and weeding well to prevent future worm problems.
